title: Guidance state machine
purpose: Drive the closed loop through explicit, deterministic states; state transitions are never controlled implicitly by an LLM.
architecturalScope: Guidance bounded context. GuidanceSession aggregate / orchestrator. Coordinates ProductRequest, VisualSearch and SpeechOutput.
domainContext: GuidanceSession, LocalizationState-like phase. States: IDLE, LISTENING, SEARCHING, TARGET_CANDIDATE, TARGET_TRACKED, GUIDING, TARGET_LOST, TARGET_REACHED, ERROR.

milestones.title: States and transitions
milestones.description: Explicit state machine with unit-tested transitions.

milestones.title: Search behaviour
milestones.description: Guides camera search when the target is not visible.

tasks.title: Define states, events and transition table
acceptanceCriteria: Happy path and loss path are covered by tests.

tasks.title: Implement search behaviour instructions
acceptanceCriteria: SEARCHING produces camera-search prompts, not invented store locations.
SEARCHING → TARGET_CANDIDATE → TARGET_TRACKED → GUIDING → TARGET_REACHED works.

risks.mitigation: Hysteresis via target tracking and speech deduplication.

safetyImplications: ERROR and TARGET_LOST states must announce uncertainty, never guess.
accessibilityImplications: Every state transition with user impact is announced in simple language.
verificationRequirements: State-transition unit tests and scenario tests.
